name: Jedi Soldier
description_md:
## Jedi Soldier
So, I really just wanted to enjoy [Haymaker](/card/01087) again. The deck became more than [Haymaker](/card/01087), but 2 for 4 damage with Winter Soldier felt fun.

## The Real Plan
Do lots of damage. [Live Dangerously](/card/44024), pick up some [Laser Swords](/card/44055), and do lots of damage. If there's time to get a [Side Holster](/card/20021) so you can play the [Winter Rifle](/card/54011), do even more lots of damage.

## The Core Set
I didn't intend to make this limited in the collection (though if you remove [Side Holster](/card/20021) and not play Winter Rifle, it's only 4 packs required), but it was fun to bring [Haymaker](/card/01087) to help with damage. I mean, don't get me wrong, Winter Soldier doesn't need _MORE_ damage. All of his events are already _*Attack*_ events. but come on...who doesn't want _MORE_ damage.

---
### Sidebar

No sidebar this time. This deck was played at all player counts without changes. It's definitely the damage dealing role

---
